title: Final Elementary Practicum
description: Deepening the practice of making professional choices for teaching and learning in holistic, Indigenous, integrative and culturally reflective ways, developing inter-professional practices with families and in community. A full-time practicum in a BC ministry approved school meeting the requirements for certification.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of IED 461, ED-P 400A, ED-P 400B, ED-P 400C, ED-P 400D, ED-P 461.
